commander_identity.mechanical_plan: Sedris grants every creature card in our graveyard its own sorcery-speed unearth 2B; turn discard/mill into high-impact hasty ETB and attack triggers, discount repeat activations with Convergence while defending the end-step exile window with Obeka, Sundial, Teferi's Veil, Thassa or Deadeye.
commander_identity.natural_ceiling: Bracket 4 optimized. Six-mana triple-color commander, graveyard vulnerability, black activation costs and end-step setup preclude substantiated cEDH consistency.
commander_identity.anti_homogenization: No Oracle/Consultation or Breach conversion, no generic staple quota. Build around Sedris-owned unearth triggers, ETB copying and timed rescue.

whole_deck_audit.roles_and_overlaps: All 99 exact canonical physical library slots reconciled against the Oct20 authored one-by-one deep review. Ten dedicated rocks, 31 lands, 2 basics of Swamp, seven original reanimation/dedicated setup lines, four rescue pieces and creature payoffs. The nine cut roles create deliberate opportunity-cost tradeoffs; retained Panharmonicon, Convergence, Kelpie, Diviner, Sundial, Obeka, Veil and Deadeye remain structurally critical.
whole_deck_audit.mana_base_and_curve: Baseline 31 physical lands with ten repeatable artifacts and a six-mana UBR commander; revision adds Cephalid Coliseum and a castable MDFC Agadeem spell-land for 33 physical land faces. Careful Study reduces setup mana; Gyruda six vs Jin ten, Delver five vs Sheoldred seven. Losing Ashnod's creature-fed colorless acceleration is mitigated by ten unchanged rocks; threshold and the untapped MDFC life tax are real.
whole_deck_audit.interaction_resilience: Preserves Force of Will, Fierce Guardianship, Deflecting Swat, Mana Drain, Deadly Rollick, Toxic Deluge, Cyclonic Rift and Feed the Swarm. Rescue stack includes Obeka/Sundial/Veil/Deadeye plus Thassa. Graveyard hate still blanks Sedris and Delver targets; no claimed protection against exiling entire grave.

weakest_slots.weakness: Converts expendable Titans and unearthed creatures into self-mill immediately, seeding later Sedris targets or milling opponents with spare tokens.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Loses the sacrifice-for-two-colorless mana engine. Unearthed creatures sacrificed this way exile, so this is not a recursive sacrifice loop.

weakest_slots.weakness: At the beginning of our end step, blink an unearthed ETB creature before its delayed exile trigger resolves; return as a new object for durable repeated ETBs.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Four mana and an exposed enchantment; removes independent discard and cast-a-creature-from-graveyard backup when Sedris is unavailable.

weakest_slots.weakness: Makes land drop 33 while retaining an expensive late-game reanimation spell as a land/spell choice, easing six-mana commander sequencing.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Loses Feldon's repeatable graveyard token copies and early-game power; Awakening has substantial black requirements and tapped or three-life land cost.

weakest_slots.weakness: Raises physical land density to 32-33 and retains a threshold looting land that draws three/discards three to bin payoffs after the graveyard develops.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Replaces a flexible instant that moves two chosen cards to grave. Coliseum only activates at threshold and sacrifices itself while paying blue.

weakest_slots.weakness: A six-mana creature ETB that mills four cards per player and converts one even-MV milled creature to our battlefield, doubled by Panharmonicon.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Gyruda may hit no eligible even-MV creature and fuels opposing graveyards; loses Jin's end-step draw-seven and rescued hand-size lockdown.

weakest_slots.weakness: One blue mana draws two and deliberately discards two expensive creatures for Sedris, speeding the pre-commander graveyard assembly.
weakest_slots.reasoning: One-shot spell replaces a recurring tap looter and its graveyard-creature copying option; lower late-game standalone utility.

weakest_slots.weakness: An unearthed Agent steals ANY target permanent immediately, and that change of control continues after Agent exiles; Panharmonicon doubles its ETB.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Seven mana and a fragile theft ETB; loses Primordial's potential three-opponent graveyard reanimation against stocked opponents.

weakest_slots.weakness: Five-mana ETB returns our best creature immediately without waiting for an upkeep that an unearthed Sheoldred normally never reaches.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Costs life equal to each target's mana value, especially sharp if Panharmonicon doubles it; forfeits Sheoldred's continuing sacrifice pressure when rescued.

weakest_slots.weakness: Three-mana instant finds a three-creature pile, making two assured graveyard unearth targets and giving the third to hand; directly tutors Sedris plans.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Loses Windfall's mass hand reset/discard and potential seven-card refill, decreases generic card velocity in stalled hands.

weakest_slots.weakness: Blink two legal artifacts/creatures/lands for a one-time rescue and repeated ETBs; removing another buried-creature tutor reduces targets Sedris actually sees.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Retained after post-floor challenge because sacrificing the incumbent engine is a worse all-matchup trade for this build.

weakest_slots.weakness: Symmetrical untap self-mill may fill more graveyard cards, but fuels rivals and loses Ripples' selective return-to-hand and predictable first-main mill.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Retained after post-floor challenge because sacrificing the incumbent engine is a worse all-matchup trade for this build.

whole_deck_audit.current_baseline_strength: Oct15 approved 100 is already strong commander-first Sedris with Archon/Titan ETBs, Flayer/Terror damage, Panharmon doubling, Deadeye/Drake, Convergence and mature fast-mana interaction. The prior approval is preserved as the baseline, not called faulty.
whole_deck_audit.candidate_pool_scope: All 99 source slots, 15 material current candidates with exact cut decisions, EDHREC Sedris Top/High Lift and OFF-RANKED self-mill/rescue, prior 111 M5 challenger pairs, Pass C Sedris Altar dilemma, two full 100-card adversarial packages, and bounded blueprint cases.
whole_deck_audit.off_ranked_search_conclusion: Off-ranking self-mill and object-zone scrutiny supports Altar over Ashnod rather than losing Panharmonicon, Thassa end-step reset, Gyruda even-MV milling, Agent permanent-theft persistence, Delver direct ETB reanimation and 33 physical land faces; extra Flicker and Orb do not beat losing buried-target density and Ripples selection.

final_changes.coherent_package_tradeoff: Nine substantive substitutions: preserve Sedris's rescue/ETB core, shift two library slots into 33 physical lands, replace slow/non-immediate reanimator bodies with Delver/Gyruda/Agent ETBs, exchange redundant auxiliary casting/sacrifice for Thassa/Altar, and sharpen single-mana grave setup/instant creature piles. Lose Ashnod mana, Chainer/Feldon backups, Jin's draw seven, Sepulchral opponent grave access, Gifts/Windfall velocity.

final_candidate.deckwide_reconciliation: Nine one-for-one exact source replacements from physical Oct15 100: final 100 physical cards, 99 names, only Swamp x2 repeats, 33 land-faced slots including one MDFC. No companion, Commander Sedris remains first, UBR, zero project exceptions.

low_swap_heightened_audit.off_ranked_opportunities: Look beyond top EDHREC tags: Altar's sacrifice mills self after unaerthed power, Thassa's end-step stack blink, Agent's lasting theft, Gyruda's ETB mill/reanimate and mana-base spell-lands replace existing genuine opportunity costs, with Panharmonicon preserved.

multi_slot_packages.result_and_rationale: Full 100 alt11 via sedris_alt11.txt: two extra blink/mill substitutions challenge Vile Entomber/Ripples but reduce deterministic grave tutor and repeated self-grave selection; withheld.
Full 100 alt9 Panharmon-cut from Stage A: keep Ashnod's mana as second outlet but lose double high-impact ETBs; strongly rejected after direct comparison.

low_swap_heightened_audit.alternate_cuts_for_prior_holds: Kept Panharmonicon against Altar because doubling Rune-Scarred, Agent, Delver, Archon and Titan ETB pays every game; found Ashnod's Altar alternative cut. Kept Sundial's correctly timed exile-trigger dismissal against Ghostly Flicker. Preserved Kelpie and Twilight as unearth identity, chose Chainer/Feldon as slower redundant backups.
low_swap_heightened_audit.strongest_argument_against_baseline: The original source has only 31 physical lands for a six-mana commander and carries deferred/upkeep creature payoffs that normally exile before activating. Current direct-ETB and land-faced options can reduce deck's setup debt while preserving rescue engines.
low_swap_heightened_audit.evidence_based_answer: The nine selected swaps replace specifically expendable auxiliary pieces, and two full alternate configurations were considered; no numeric win-rate claim. Retained sources still have role advantages, so nine is a quality stop after additional post-floor challengers, not a count target.

open_ended_optimization_audit.remaining_99_review: After nine swaps crossed the presentation floor, challenged other retained original slots including Ripples, Vile Entomber, Teferi's Veil, Etali, Victimize and Obeka, inspected two source-bound full-100 packages, and kept mana/ETB protection/targeted graveyard filling instead of padding the list.

post_floor_challenges.tradeoff: Two-target blink can save two unearthed objects but costs a buried-creature tutor; source deck is activation-target limited and already has five rescue lines.
Orb mills potentially more but symmetrical risk and random resources are inferior to first-main Ripples controllable mill-plus-buy hand access.

larger_swap_packages.case_for_extra_swaps: Two more high-lift setup/rescue cards can increase volume of milled grave creatures and save two ETB bodies simultaneously in long, slow games.
larger_swap_packages.why_not_selected: Sacrifices best creature Entomb-on-ETB and a repeatable first-main draw-to-hand chooser; protects rescue redundancy at cost of always-needed precise grave targets and card access.

open_ended_optimization_audit.quality_based_stop_reason: The additional two actual 100-card substitutions marginally increase rescue and random grave fill, but Vile Entomber's deterministic target and Ripples' early selective mill are more valuable in the six-mana Sedris plan; Ancient Brass, Discontinuity, Closet and Incarnation Technique similarly lose measurable retained unique roles. No padding.
